<div  class="module module-text tb_h57h609  repeat " data-lazy="1">
            <div  class="tb_text_wrap">
    <div id="u42313-6" class="maintitle02 clearfix">
<h1 class="akyaka_no22" style="text-align: center; font-size: 3.3em; line-height: 1em; letter-spacing: -0.03em;"><strong class="akyaka_no22"> NO22 RIDERS&#8217; INN IS THE HABITAT IN GOKOVA &#8211; AKYAKA FOR THOSE WHO<br />
LOVE EXTREME SPORTS, GOOD FOOD<br />
AND HIGH TIME. </strong></h1>
</div>
<div id="u42383-13" class="bodycopy clearfix">
<hr />
<p style="text-align: center; font-size: 24px!important; line-height: 29px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'freight-display-pro-n3';">A meeting point for those who have already moved to this unique view—where emerald green meets the turquoise sea—and for those who still dream of it. A hotel, a restaurant, a bar, and much more…</p>
<p style="text-align: center; font-size: 24px!important; line-height: 29px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'freight-display-pro-n3';">Akyaka has recently become the number one alternative holiday destination, offering visitors adrenaline-filled activities like kite surfing, cycling, motocross, trekking, canoeing, SUP, and more. During the day, you can enjoy dishes from our #Momomeets22 concept kitchen, and at night, experience live music and DJ performances on the No 22 Riders’ Inn stage. For accommodation, you can also stay at No 22 Riders’ Inn, conveniently located in the heart of the town.</p>
</div>
